whatsappMessage:
Hi Ahmadia Restaurant team,

I noticed your restaurant has a solid 4.2★ reputation near New Market in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and direct table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme digital food menu, direct WhatsApp takeaway ordering, aur Fraser Road location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://ahmadia-restaurant-demo.web.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ahmadia Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with digital menu showcase and direct WhatsApp food ordering for your Fraser Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, pricing, aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
